title: Host adapter layout
description: Where each piece of a host's installable bundle comes from and where it lands. Read by scripts/build_adapter.py, which knows nothing about any particular host: a new host is a new directory and a new layout, not an edit to shared code. Sources resolve against adapters/<host>/ first and the repository root second, so moving a file into the adapter directory is a move rather than a layout change.

host.description: Must match the directory name and the host manifest, so a layout cannot describe a host it is not filed under.

bundle_root.description: Where the plugin itself sits inside the bundle. '.' means the bundle IS the plugin, which is what a marketplace source of './' requires.

description.description: Why this host's bundle is shaped the way it is. Not decoration: a layout that differs from its siblings needs a reason on record.

place.description: source -> destination. A trailing slash on both sides copies a directory tree; without one, a single file. Destinations are relative to the bundle, not to bundle_root, so a file that must sit above the plugin (a marketplace manifest, say) can say so.

exclude.description: Glob patterns dropped from every copied tree. Build artifacts only -- never a way to keep something out of the bundle that the plugin needs, which would make the gate pass over a broken install.
